title: Vue not able to extract prop from `ReadonlyArray` and `readonly`

labels.name: :hammer: p3-minor-bug
labels.description: Priority 3: this fixes a bug, but is an edge case that only affects very specific usage.

body:
### Vue version

3.4.23

### Link to minimal reproduction

https://play.vuejs.org/#

### Steps to reproduce

`readonly number[]` -- https://play.vuejs.org/#

Causes `"modelValue": { type: [Boolean, String], skipCheck: true },`

`ReadonlyArray<number>` https://play.vuejs.org/#

Causes `"modelValue": { type: [Boolean, String], skipCheck: true },`

`Readonly<number[]>` https://play.vuejs.org/#

Causes `"modelValue": { type: [Boolean, String, Object, Number, null] },`

Inspect the Comp.vue dist js prop definitions

### What is expected?

All three variations should have modelvalue be `"modelValue": { type: [Boolean, String, Object, Number, null] },`

### What is actually happening?

Vue not able to `readonly` or `ReadonlyArray` as `Object`
